rows.title: Send 15 former N/A places to Gemini: they have a real surf scene
rows.detail:
Amsterdam: Wijk aan Zee is about 30 minutes away and has surf schools and rentals; Zandvoort, 30 minutes away, also has schools. North Sea beach breaks, season about March to October.
Andalucía: The Atlantic coast of Cádiz (El Palmar, Los Caños de Meca, Conil) has year-round surf schools and camps, and Tarifa is a winter base. Best in autumn, winter and spring.
Bordeaux: Lacanau is about an hour away: sandbank beach breaks, several surf schools, and a Bordeaux surf school that runs day trips.
Malaysian Borneo: Sabah has a young but real scene: Kudat and Tanjung Simpang Mengayau (waves to about 6 ft, best December to March) and Karambunai near Kota Kinabalu, which has hosted the Borneo Surf Festival and lessons.
Edinburgh: Belhaven Bay at Dunbar (a surf school since 2004, about an hour away) and Pease Bay (Momentum Surf School) in East Lothian. Cold North Sea, best September to February.
Hokkaido: Surf exists on both coasts, mostly empty and very cold (drysuit in winter). Sources are thin on named spots and schools, so this one is a judgment call for Gemini.
Istanbul: Kilyos is about an hour and 15 minutes away on the Black Sea with surf schools; Kerpe, about an hour away, has a surf academy. Short summer season and winter swell.
Quebec City & Montreal: Montreal has a river-wave scene on the St. Lawrence (Habitat 67 and Big Joe) with schools (KSF, Imagine Surfboards), May to October.
Rome: Ostia and Fregene have several surf schools (some since 2005 and 2006), but waves are small and come mostly ahead of southern storms. A judgment call for Gemini.
Seoul: Yangyang (Jukdo and Ingu beaches) is about two hours away with over 100 surf businesses and year-round schools; Korea's main surf scene.
Wales: Wales has a real coastal scene: Llangennith and Rhossili on the Gower, and Freshwater West in Pembrokeshire, with schools. Biggest in winter.
Southeast Alaska & the Inside Passage: Yakutat is Alaska's best-known surf town (daily jet service and ferry stops; best mid-April to mid-June and August to September) and Sitka's Sandy Beach is reachable by road in winter.
Tokyo & Kyoto: Shonan is under an hour and a half from Tokyo and Chiba (Ichinomiya, an Olympic surf venue) about 1.5 hours away, with over 20 surf shops along its beach road. Best August to October.
Tuscany: Versilia (Viareggio, Cinquale) is called the surfing capital of Italy, with a Livorno scene and schools near San Vincenzo and Punta Ala. Best in autumn and winter storms.
Upper Peninsula: Lake Superior surfing around Marquette (Presque Isle, Grand Marais), in fall and winter storms until the ice. There is no surf shop in Marquette, so this is a judgment call for Gemini.

Closed 14 Oct 2026: All 15 were sent to Gemini in the v5 surfing run (13 Oct 2026) and the drafts are staged for review.

rows.title: Fill "How you do it" for the 41 places that said "Several styles"
rows.detail: The column is now a multi-select (day boat, shore or house reef, liveaboard). The old answer "Several styles" says nothing, so those 41 cells were cleared on 13 Oct 2026 rather than guessed. Research each place and pick every way that applies. A backup of the old values is in docs/backups/diving-facts-before-units-and-access-2026-10-13.json. Filter the Places & data tab to see the blanks.
